_comment: Parts you can't buy: each one is somewhere in the city (scripts/world/found_part.gd). `near` is a barn find (barn:<car id>), a job site (site:<id>) or a photo spot (photo:<id>) from data/world/places.json or the map; `offset` is metres east, up and south of it; optional `yaw` turns it (wheels lean toward their local -X). `rumour` shows in the phone's Leads tab until it's found. Stop next to it or walk up to it to take it home.

parts.rumour: The warehouse on Royal Street had a set of old magnesium wheels leaning by the roller door.
Someone left an Abarth tailpipe on the bench of a Kensington shed.
There's a rack and an old single-fin out the back of the Cottesloe surf club. Nobody's claimed it.
A pair of chrome spotlights is sitting on a wall along Mounts Bay Road in Crawley.
